verdict.rationale: ROS 2's own rosbag tooling records robot data and provides a Python API for reading recorded bags from user code, which covers programmatic access to collected data for offline analysis. Community users also cite data bagging as a built-in benefit. Missing for 10: any documented SQL query interface, any export to analysis formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet), any query or filter capabilities over recorded data, and hands-on corroboration of offline analysis workflows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query and export collected robot data through an API or SQL for offline analysis

citations.quote: It also provides a Python API for reading from and writing to a bag from your own source code.
This allows you to subscribe to a topic and save the received data to a bag at the same time as performing any other processing of your choice on that data.
